source.title: GT-G3-00 G3 Basic Canonical Canvas P30 Implementation Plan v0.1

trusted_statements.goal: Introduce the minimal renderer-neutral canonical-surface lifecycle and PresentationTracker that keep acquire/resize/present generation-bound and preserve PresentSubmitted != Presented.
owns: PresentedFeedback correlation and deterministic stale-generation rejection

fixed_semantics.identity_namespaces: ViewId, FrameId, SurfaceGeneration, and MetricsGeneration remain distinct and are compared by exact typed identity.
fixed_semantics.live_surface: One per-view live surface snapshot binds nonzero SurfaceGeneration, nonzero MetricsGeneration, valid SurfaceMetrics, and availability. It owns no native handle or backend object.
fixed_semantics.acquire: Acquire returns only the current immutable available snapshot. An unavailable/lost surface returns a typed rejection and no stale target.
fixed_semantics.resize_or_rebind: SurfaceGeneration and MetricsGeneration advance independently without regression. A metrics-only resize keeps SurfaceGeneration equal and requires strictly newer MetricsGeneration. A surface rebind requires strictly newer SurfaceGeneration and a valid nondecreasing MetricsGeneration, which may remain equal when metrics are unchanged. Both-equal, either-regressing, wrong-view, invalid, or zero-generation replacements are deterministic rejections preserving the prior live snapshot. After loss, rebind requires strictly newer SurfaceGeneration.
fixed_semantics.submission: Present submission accepts exactly one FrameState only when view, surface generation, metrics generation, and SurfaceMetrics exactly match the live snapshot. Acceptance records PresentSubmitted but cannot set Presented.
fixed_semantics.feedback: Feedback binds exact ViewId, FrameId, SurfaceGeneration, MetricsGeneration, outcome, evidence kind, and optional presented_time_ns. Unknown frames, wrong view, old/live-mismatched generations, and post-loss feedback cannot change presented state.
fixed_semantics.presented_transition: Only Presented outcome with PlatformQualified evidence, exact submitted-frame correlation, and exact current live surface/metrics generations transitions that record to Presented. Approximate/None, Dropped/Failed/Unknown, or mere submit cannot do so.
fixed_semantics.duplicates: Duplicate terminal feedback is idempotent and cannot advance another frame or generation.
fixed_semantics.surface_loss: Loss makes acquire fail and all prior-generation feedback stale while preserving canonical semantic and RuntimeScene state outside this module. A later rebind requires strictly newer generations.
fixed_semantics.scope_limit: CanonicalVisible, FrameCoverageManifest, Arc tokens/clear, platform proof primitives, scheduling, and native host surfaces remain successor work.

forbidden: native window, swapchain, CAMetalLayer, WebGL, or platform surface types
Skia API or Headless raster implementation changes
CanonicalVisible, ArcCanonicalToken, preview clearing, or FrameCoverageManifest implementation
RuntimeScene, SceneQuery, semantic, ObjectStore, or G2 changes
Tile, RenderGroup, RasterCache, Scheduler, ResourceBudget, or final FrameGraph ABI
